description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged jump attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Wind with Stacking], [Awoken Dragoon], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Steadfast Pilot Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Wind with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Wind Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Wind 3

description.name: Awoken Dragoon
description.text: Dragoon abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Jump attacks

description.name: Steadfast Pilot Mode
description.text: Casts Aero Descent after another ally casts a Wind ability, removed after triggering three times, casts High Climb when removed
